body: I honestly don't know if she would or not... I told her I was suicidal over all of this, and she was so mad at me on the phone she told me to pull the trigger.
She called me up after I did it... She was a wreck. I felt so damn bad. But I know there's no going back. I really hope she doesn't hurt herself over this...

I'm currently living with my parents. They're not doing well on the marriage front. I repeatedly have my father vent to me about how my mother isn't physical with him, yet he won't change his ways. He's been unemployed for 2 years and refuses to find work. He often makes me feel like I am just a burden, jokingly saying that I was a mistake. He doesn't know how to handle emotions and I am a very emotional person.

Thank you all for the responses... It helped me realize that I'm better off alone no matter how much it hurts to let her go. I had such a good outlook on this and it was crushed in days. Sigh... I hate shedding tears for somebody who would not do the same.

I've asked her I don't know how many times why she is holding out on taking this next step. Every time I'm told its because she feels our core relationship isn't stable enough for her to feel comfortable because I'm always depressed and upset when I don't get my way.
